paragraphs.text: Seeing that God in this way preferred Jacob their father, Judah's ingratitude was the more to be abhorred.

paragraphs.text: God found Jacob as he lay sleeping in Bethel Ge 28:12, and spoke with him there in such a way that the fruit of that speech appertained to the whole body of the people, of which we are.

paragraphs.text: As for Ephraim, he is more like the wicked Canaanites than godly Abraham or Jacob.

paragraphs.text: Thus way the wicked measure God's favour by outward prosperity, and like hypocrites cannot endure that any should reprove their doings.
